import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = -(p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t + p[3]*np.exp(-t))
    amp = p[4] + p[5]*t
    k = np.exp(p[6] + p[7]*t)
    n = p[8] + p[9]*t
    return base + amp*(1 - np.exp(-k*np.abs(A)**n))

def equation(t, A, params):

import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = -(p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t + p[3]*np.exp(-t))
    amp = p[4] + p[5]*t + p[6]*t**2
    S = np.exp(-np.exp(p[7])*np.abs(A)**p[8]*t**p[9])
    return base + amp*(1 - S)
